caption:
Behind every bristle is a factory you can trust. 🏭

Part 2 of our introduction series: About Us.

Our factory in Tangerang, Indonesia has been fully operating since February 2026 with modern filament machines, with capacity of up to 5 tons per day for domestic and export markets. We use recycled plastic raw materials, making our production more eco-friendly.

Our values are simple:
✅ Consistent quality
♻️ Eco-friendly production
🤝 Long-term partnership

We are proud to be trusted by the Nagoya brand (PT Benli Indonesia), and we supply almost all of their broom and brush bristles. Our factory is open for visits, so come and see how we work.

Request a sample via WhatsApp +62 831-6591-3330 or send us a DM.

For international buyers: our Indonesian nylon filament factory welcomes OEM and private label inquiries, and offers sample requests and factory visits. Contact us today.
